Dark Knight
The Dark Knight is a fearless warrior with high strength and agility. They use their special abilities to deal powerful physical attacks on enemies with sword type weapons. Their unique ability to wield two swords at once can unleash hell on its enemies from the weapon damage bonus these character's receive by equipping identical swords! The Dark Knight is home to Lorencia with a long history there. These dedicated warriors fight tirelessly to bring Kundun's reign to an end!

Class Specialization...
Each character has unique specialization bonuses.
x2 Weapon Bonus
Equipping two weapons increases weapon DMG!
Any two weapons: +10% DMG
Two identical weapons: +30% DMG
Strength stat bonus
Adding stat points in STR increases ATK DMG!
0 ~ 1,500 points: +0% ~ +10% increase
1,501 ~ 2,000 points: +10% ~ +30% increase
2,001+ points: +30% up to +45% increase
Agility stat bonus
Adding stat points in AGI increases DEF!
0 ~ 1,500 points: +0% ~ +10% increase
1,501 ~ 2,000 points: +10% ~ +30% increase
2,001+ points: +30% up to +45% increase
Party Set Bonus
Gain increased EXP gain when in a party with:
Dark Knight
Fairy Elf
Dark Wizard
Class Evolution...
All characters evolve through a series of classes after reaching a specific character level and after completing main quests.
Dark Knight (1st class)
Stops gaining EXP at Level 400.
Evolves into Blade Knight after:
Reaching Character Level 150.
Completing the 2nd Class Upgrade quest.
Blade Knight (2nd class)
Unlocks the 'Combo' ability.
Stops gaining EXP at Level 400.
Evolves into Blade Master after:
Reaching Character Level 400.
Completing the 3rd Class Upgrade quest.
Blade Master (3rd class)
Unlocks the 'Master Skill Tree.'
Stops gaining EXP at Level 800.
Evolves into Dragon Knight.
Reaching Character Level 800.
Completing the 4th Class Upgrade quest.
Dragon Knight (4th class)
Unlocks the 'Skill Enhancement Tree.'
Stops gaining EXP at Level 1450.
